items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I was Paul Barrett for a year when he died.

ctx.x: I was wondering if he played much like at the time that you went to Chicago, was he still active as a musician then? Yeah. Still working? Yeah. Yeah. Well 1930, even by Buddy McKee's death, he was still? Yeah, he was playing. Still playing. Mm-hmm. I'm going to ask a little bit about Kid Rene, if you heard him very much, how he played. I even met him and heard him play, but he was not very well when I heard him. Well when you heard him, he was shot up then.
Yeah. But he was wonderful. He was really good. Yeah, really good. I was Paul Barrett for a year when he died.
Now did you ever play with him in any brass bands? Yeah.
